crossed_cluster_resampling.limitations: Only 10 new date clusters, 2-3/month. Reweights repeated security globally; not an exact SRSWOR two-stage bootstrap and no significance claim.

design_weighted_incidence.assumptions: Independent randomized date/security draws, fixed finite outcomes, SRSWOR within both strata; only 2-3 dates/month. No normal/iid confidence interval.

two_way_cluster_sensitivity.caveat: Date + security - intersection score variance; not a calibrated small-sample significance test.
